Exercise: Single Leg Push-off

Category:
plyometrics

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
push

Difficulty Level:
beginner

Movement Patterns:

- vertical_jump

Primary Muscles:

- quadriceps

Secondary Muscles:

- calves
- hamstrings

Equipment:

- other

Fatigue Score:
3

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
0.8

Energy Requirement:
high

Recovery Time:
24 hours

Goals:

- improve_explosive_power_in_the_legs
- enhance_lower_body_strength_and_power

Contraindications:

- Individuals with knee or ankle injuries should consult a healthcare professional before attempting this exercise.

Exercise Variations:

- name: Single Leg Push-off with Dumbbell, force: push, level: intermediate, mechanic: compound, equipment: dumbbell

Substitution Options:

- name: Box Jump, force: vertical jump, level: beginner, mechanic: compound, equipment: box

Instructions:

- Stand on the ground with one foot resting on the box, heel close to the edge.
- Push off with your foot on top of the box, trying to gain as much height as possible by extending through the hip and knee.
- Land with the same foot on top of the box, returning your other foot back to the start position.
